findings.title: Missing Security Header: Strict-Transport-Security
findings.description: Missing Strict-Transport-Security (HSTS) header. (Target: http://localhost:3000)
findings.remediation: Enable HSTS in web server response headers (e.g. Strict-Transport-Security: max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains).

findings.title: Missing Security Header: Content-Security-Policy
findings.description: Missing Content-Security-Policy (CSP) header. (Target: http://localhost:3000)
findings.remediation: Define a restrictive Content-Security-Policy header to prevent XSS and data injection attacks.

findings.title: Missing Security Header: X-Frame-Options
findings.description: Missing X-Frame-Options header (Clickjacking Risk). (Target: http://localhost:3000)
findings.remediation: Configure X-Frame-Options: DENY or SAMEORIGIN to protect against clickjacking attacks.

findings.title: Missing Security Header: X-Content-Type-Options
findings.description: Missing X-Content-Type-Options header. (Target: http://localhost:3000)
findings.remediation: Set X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff to prevent MIME-type sniffing.

findings.title: Missing Security Header: Referrer-Policy
findings.description: Missing Referrer-Policy header. (Target: http://localhost:3000)
findings.remediation: Set Referrer-Policy: strict-origin-when-cross-origin to limit referrer leakage.
